Message:
It wasn’t long after
I was brought to live
at an orphanage.

I was told I could start fresh,
build a new life here...

But, as long as I could continue
to play with my fairies...

“Hi there!
And what are you up to?”

I won’t talk to myself again,
so please...don’t hurt me...!”

“...No, no, it’s okay.
I just wanted to say,
you can see them too, huh?”

“The most I can manage to do
is sense their presence.
I was told even being able
to do that much is a rarity...

But, for you to be able to see
angels’ lights so clearly...”

She knelt down to
look at me face-to-face,
gently wiping away my tears.
